notes.title: 0.873 Released!
notes.content:
I've added 42 achievements for you guys, go check it out!
Most of these achievements are easy to unlock.
These are also achievements for challengers. 
Achievements

Also fixed some bugs:
- In 2 players mode, the game can't pause if player 1 is dead.
- Now player 2 can call pause menu.(It's a big freaking bug in UE4, I was banging my head against the wall for some time :0)
- Another UE4 bug that if 1P pauses the game and resume, 2P will stop receiving inputs from controller. 
- fast mode bug.
- other minor bugs that I can't remember now got fixed.

The stage 1-2 is working in progress now, will be released soon, and there might be a minor rise in the price.

One more thing, I've shut down the Indiegogo page.
I did not host any crowdfunding page. And if I'm gonna, I'll also post an announcement here.
So if there are any crowdfunding pages about my game, they must be scams,.

notes.title: 0.872 Version Released!
notes.content:
Firstly, please accept my apologies.
I misplaced a number in easy mode so level 1-1 became even harder than hard mode. 
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31164778/e0e3c4645b46f45cfc9a4769b58d1c757d329103.gif
But I've fixed it.

And here's a detailed list changed in 0.872 version.

- Brand new training level. Please have a try and tell me what do you think.
- Now Escape key opens menu during gameplay.
- A fast game over mode has been added. Now you can skip the game over screen and restart from the last checkpoint immediately.
- Soundtracks update.
- Added an option to the pause screen to allow player restart game from the last checkpoint.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes the game freezes at the game clear screen.
- Fixed a bug that turrets receiving damage from an unknown source.
- Fixed a configuration of level 1-1 in easy mode. (oops)

Demo version got fixed too.

Cheer!
